g.text: Model Y 2026.38.6.1 on the Sigenergy DC charger, 7 Nov 2026: both 25 kW sessions ended by the car
Source: Home Assistant history (Sigenergy Modbus and Teslemetry). Plant under Amber V2X dispatch (Remote EMS off). A = 7:36:50 to 7:48:35 pm AEST, B = 7:53:21 to 8:07:02 pm AEST.
Ah from charger output power / vehicle voltage; the discharging current sensor agrees within 0.01 Ah.
